info.name: Agriculture API
info.description:
# Agriculture API Collection

This collection covers all endpoints for the Agriculture Afforestation Tracking System.

The system is used to record and manage tree planting (afforestation) achievements — tracking **who planted**, **what tree**, **where**, **how many**, and **when**.

---

## How to Use

1. Set the `baseUrl` variable to your server (e.g. `https://localhost:7001` for local, or your deployed server URL).
2. Start with **Auth → Login** to get a JWT token.
3. The token is saved automatically to the `token` variable for use in other requests.

---

## Roles
- `0` = Admin
- `1` = User
- `2` = Viewer

## Setup Order (first time)
1. Register or Login
2. Add Location Types
3. Add Locations
4. Add Tree Types
5. Add Trees
6. Add Afforestation Records

item.name: Auth (User)
item.description: Authentication and user management endpoints. Start here — login first to get a token.

request.description:
## Login

Authenticates a user and returns a JWT token.

### Request Body
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| email | string | Yes | User's email |
| password | string | Yes | User's password |

### Success Response (200)
```json
{
  "token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIs...",
  "role": "Admin",
  "id": 1,
  "email": "admin@agriculture.com"
}
```

### Failure Response (401)
`Unauthorized` — wrong email or password.

> **The token is saved automatically** to the `token` variable so all other requests use it.

## Register User

Registers a new user. No token required — this endpoint is public.

### Request Body
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| name | string | Yes | Full name |
| email | string | Yes | Email address |
| password | string | Yes | Password |
| role | int | Yes | 0 = Admin, 1 = User, 2 = Viewer |

### Success Response (200)
`"Registration successful."`

### Failure (400)
`"Email already registered."` — email is already in use.

### Notes
- Use **Register Admin** endpoint if you want to force-register an Admin (requires Admin token).

## Register Admin

Registers a new user and forces the role to **Admin**, regardless of what is sent in the body.

This endpoint is public — no token required. Use it to create your first Admin account.

### Request Body
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| name | string | Yes | Full name |
| email | string | Yes | Email |
| password | string | Yes | Password |
| role | int | Ignored | Always set to Admin (0) |

### Success Response (200)
`"Registration successful."`

### Failure (400)
`"Email already registered."` — email is already in use.

## Get All Users

Returns a list of all registered users.

> **Requires:** JWT token.

### Success Response (200)
```json
[
  {
    "id": 1,
    "name": "Ahmed Mohamed",
    "email": "ahmed@agriculture.com",
    "role": 1
  }
]
```

## Get User By ID

Returns a single user by their ID.

> **Requires:** JWT token.

### Path Parameter
| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| id | int | The user's ID |

### Success Response (200)
```json
{
  "id": 1,
  "name": "Ahmed Mohamed",
  "email": "ahmed@agriculture.com",
  "role": 1
}
```

### Failure (404)
User not found.

## Update User

Updates an existing user's information.

### Request Body
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| id | int | Yes | The user's ID to update |
| name | string | No | New full name |
| email | string | No | New email |
| password | string | No | New password |

### Success Response (200)
Empty 200 OK.

## Delete User

Permanently deletes a user by ID.

### Path Parameter
| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| id | int | The user's ID to delete |

### Success Response (200)
Empty 200 OK.

### Failure (404)
User not found — returns error message.

item.name: Tree Types
item.description: Manage tree categories (e.g. Fruit Trees, Forest Trees, Ornamental Trees). These are the top-level categories that Tree Names belong to.

request.description:
## Get All Tree Types

Returns all tree type categories.

### Success Response (200)
```json
[
  { "id": 1, "type": "Fruit Trees" },
  { "id": 2, "type": "Forest Trees" }
]
```

## Get Tree Type By ID

Returns a single tree type by its ID.

### Path Parameter
| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| id | int | Tree type ID |

### Success Response (200)
```json
{ "id": 1, "type": "Fruit Trees" }
```

### Failure (404)
Not found.

## Add New Tree Type

Creates a new tree category.

### Request Body
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| type | string | Yes | Name of the tree category (e.g. "Fruit Trees") |

### Success Response (200)
`"Type Fruit Trees Added"`

## Update Tree Type

Updates an existing tree type category.

### Request Body
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| id | int | Yes | ID of the type to update |
| type | string | Yes | New name (cannot be empty) |

### Success Response (200)
`"Type Fruit Trees Updated Updated"`

### Failure (400)
If `type` is empty.

### Failure (404)
ID not found.

## Delete Tree Type

Deletes a tree type by ID.

### Path Parameter
| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| id | int | Tree type ID to delete |

### Success Response (200)
`"Type 1 Deleted"`

### Failure (404)
`"Type 1 Not Deleted"` — ID not found.

item.name: Trees (Tree Names)
item.description: Manage individual tree species/names. Each tree belongs to a Tree Type. Trees also have an optional scientific name.

request.description:
## Get All Trees

Returns all tree names/species in the system.

### Success Response (200)
```json
[
  {
    "id": 1,
    "name": "Apple",
    "scientificName": "Malus domestica",
    "typeId": 1
  }
]
```

## Get Tree By ID

Returns a single tree by ID.

### Path Parameter
| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| id | int | Tree ID |

### Success Response (200)
```json
{
  "id": 1,
  "name": "Apple",
  "scientificName": "Malus domestica",
  "typeId": 1
}
```

### Failure (404)
Not found.

## Get Trees By Type ID

Returns all trees that belong to a specific tree type category.

Useful for **cascading dropdowns** in the Flutter app: when user selects a Tree Type, load the trees of that type.

### Path Parameter
| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| typeId | int | Tree Type ID |

### Success Response (200)
```json
[
  { "id": 1, "name": "Apple", "scientificName": "Malus domestica", "typeId": 1 }
]
```

### Failure (404) — Two cases
- `"Type is not exist"` — the typeId doesn't exist at all
- `"Type is exist but no tree Assigned to"` — valid type but no trees added yet

## Add New Tree

Adds a new tree species/name to the system.

### Request Body
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| name | string | Yes | Common name (e.g. "Apple") |
| scientificName | string | No | Scientific name (e.g. "Malus domestica") |
| typeId | int | Yes | ID of the Tree Type this tree belongs to |

### Success Response (200)
Empty 200 OK.

## Update Tree

Updates an existing tree.

### Request Body
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| id | int | Yes | Tree ID (must be > 0) |
| name | string | No | New common name |
| scientificName | string | No | New scientific name |
| typeId | int | No | New tree type ID |

### Success Response (200)
`"Tree updated successfully."`

### Failure (400)
`id` is 0 or body is null.

### Failure (404)
Tree not found.

## Delete Tree

Permanently deletes a tree by ID.

### Path Parameter
| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| id | int | Tree ID to delete |

### Success Response (200)
`"Tree with 1 deleted successfully."`

### Failure (404)
`"Tree with 1 not found."`

item.name: Afforestation Records
item.description:
The core of the system. Each record represents a planting event: who planted, what tree (name + type), where (location + location type), how many trees, and on what date.

## Record Fields
- `dateOfPlanted` — date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format
- `treeTypeId` — must exist in Tree Types
- `treeNameId` — must exist in Trees and belong to the treeTypeId
- `locationTypeId` — must exist in Location Types
- `locationNameId` — must exist in Locations and belong to the locationTypeId
- `userId` — must exist in Users
- `number` — count of trees planted

request.description:
## Search Afforestation Records (All Results)

Searches records with optional filters and returns **all matching results** (no pagination).

Send `null` for any filter you don't want to apply — passing all nulls returns every record.

### Request Body (all fields optional)
| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| fromDate | string (YYYY-MM-DD) | Filter records planted on or after this date |
| toDate | string (YYYY-MM-DD) | Filter records planted on or before this date |
| selectedUserId | int | Filter by a specific user |
| selectedLocationId | int | Filter by a specific location |
| selectedTreeId | int | Filter by a specific tree species |

### Example — Filter by date range and user
```json
{
  "fromDate": "2025-01-01",
  "toDate": "2025-12-31",
  "selectedUserId": 2,
  "selectedLocationId": null,
  "selectedTreeId": null
}
```

### Success Response (200)
```json
[
  {
    "id": 1,
    "dateOfPlanted": "2025-06-15",
    "treeName": "Apple",
    "treeNameId": 1,
    "scientificName": "Malus domestica",
    "treeTypeName": "Fruit Trees",
    "treeTypeId": 1,
    "locationId": 1,
    "locationTypeId": 1,
    "locationTypeName": "City",
    "locationName": "Cairo",
    "userName": "Ahmed Mohamed",
    "number": 50
  }
]
```

> Results are ordered by `dateOfPlanted` ascending.

## Search Afforestation Records (Paginated)

Same filters as the regular search, but returns results in pages. Use this for lists in the Flutter app.

### Query Parameters
| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| page | int | 1 | Page number (1-based) |
| pageSize | int | 10 | Records per page |

### Request Body
Same as **Search Records (All Results)** — all filters optional.

### Success Response (200)
```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "dateOfPlanted": "2025-06-15",
      "treeName": "Apple",
      "treeNameId": 1,
      "scientificName": "Malus domestica",
      "treeTypeName": "Fruit Trees",
      "treeTypeId": 1,
      "locationId": 1,
      "locationTypeId": 1,
      "locationTypeName": "City",
      "locationName": "Cairo",
      "userName": "Ahmed Mohamed",
      "number": 50
    }
  ],
  "totalCount": 100,
  "page": 1,
  "pageSize": 10
}
```

### Flutter Usage Example
- Page 1: `?page=1&pageSize=20`
- Page 2: `?page=2&pageSize=20`
- Total pages = `ceil(totalCount / pageSize)`

## Get Afforestation Record By ID

Returns the full details of a single planting record.

### Path Parameter
| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| id | int | Record ID |

### Success Response (200)
```json
{
  "id": 1,
  "dateOfPlanted": "2025-06-15",
  "treeName": "Apple",
  "treeNameId": 1,
  "scientificName": "Malus domestica",
  "treeTypeName": "Fruit Trees",
  "treeTypeId": 1,
  "locationId": 1,
  "locationTypeId": 1,
  "locationTypeName": "City",
  "locationName": "Cairo",
  "userName": "Ahmed Mohamed",
  "number": 50
}
```

### Failure (404)
```json
{ "success": false, "message": "Record not found" }
```

## Add New Afforestation Record

Creates a new planting record. This is the main data entry endpoint of the whole system.

### Request Body
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| dateOfPlanted | string (YYYY-MM-DD) | Yes | Date the trees were planted |
| treeTypeId | int | Yes | Tree type category ID |
| treeNameId | int | Yes | Specific tree species ID |
| locationTypeId | int | Yes | Location type category ID |
| locationNameId | int | Yes | Specific location ID |
| userId | int | Yes | ID of the user who did the planting |
| number | int | Yes | Number of trees planted |

### Success Response (200)
Returns the submitted DTO back:
```json
{
  "dateOfPlanted": "2025-06-15",
  "treeTypeId": 1,
  "treeNameId": 1,
  "locationTypeId": 1,
  "locationNameId": 1,
  "userId": 1,
  "number": 50
}
```

### Important
All IDs must be valid existing records. The API does not validate FK existence at the controller level — invalid IDs will cause a database error.

## Update Afforestation Record

Partially updates an existing planting record. Only the fields you provide (non-null) will be updated.

### Path Parameter
| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| id | int | Record ID to update |

### Request Body (all fields optional except id)
| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| id | int | Record ID (must match path ID) |
| dateOfPlanted | string (YYYY-MM-DD) | New date |
| treeTypeId | int | New tree type |
| treeNameId | int | New tree species |
| locationId | int | New location (note: field is `locationId`, not `locationNameId`) |
| locationTypeId | int | New location type |
| number | int | New count of trees |

### Success Response (200)
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Record updated successfully",
  "updatedData": { ... }
}
```

### Failure (404)
```json
{ "success": false, "message": "Record not found" }
```

## Delete Afforestation Record

Permanently deletes a planting record.

### Path Parameter
| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| id | int | Record ID to delete |

### Success Response (200)
`"Record deleted successfully"`

### Failure (404)
Record not found.

## Export Afforestation Records to Excel

Exports afforestation records matching the given filters as a downloadable `.xlsx` Excel file.

Send `null` for any filter you don't want to apply — passing all nulls exports every record.

---

### Request Body (all fields optional)
| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| fromDate | string (YYYY-MM-DD) | Export records planted on or after this date |
| toDate | string (YYYY-MM-DD) | Export records planted on or before this date |
| selectedUserId | int | Filter by a specific user ID |
| selectedLocationId | int | Filter by a specific location ID |
| selectedTreeId | int | Filter by a specific tree species ID |

### Example — Export records for a date range
```json
{
  "fromDate": "2025-01-01",
  "toDate": "2025-12-31",
  "selectedUserId": null,
  "selectedLocationId": null,
  "selectedTreeId": null
}
```

---

### Success Response (200)
Returns a binary `.xlsx` file download.

**Content-Type:** `application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet`

**File name format:** `Afforestation(dd-MM-yyyy) to (dd-MM-yyyy).xlsx`

If no date filters are applied, the file is named: `Afforestation(All) to (All).xlsx`

**Excel columns (in order):**
| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| Date Planted | Date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format |
| Plant Name | Common tree name |
| Scientific Name | Scientific tree name |
| Plant Type | Tree type category |
| Location Name | Location name |
| Number | Number of trees planted |
| User Name | Name of the user who planted |

---

### Failure (400)
`"No data found for the given filters."` — no records matched the filters.

---

> **In Postman:** Click **Send and Download** (not Send) to save the file to your computer.
